evidence.title: Cate README
evidence.locator: Install table; What is inside; Shared workspaces and remote access
evidence.finding: Infinite-canvas IDE for parallel coding agents. Install: macOS DMG/ZIP arm64+x64, Windows NSIS/ZIP x64, Linux AppImage/DEB/tar.gz x64, plus Homebrew cask. Features: shared live workspaces, agent-aware terminals with running/waiting/finished states, sessions survive restarts with resume, shared prompt queues, usage overview by time/agent/model plus Claude/Codex subscription limits, git worktrees with colored canvas territories, panels on canvas or dock, multi-repo git with side-by-side diffs, ripgrep search, Cmd+K. Share pairs devices by QR/code over LAN or Cate Connect with end-to-end encryption; Availability choices: finish running work, stay available, stop with Cate.

evidence.title: Cate architecture
evidence.finding: The runtime is the application: one daemon per workspace; clients (desktop Electron+React shell, iPhone SwiftUI shell) render runtime state. Transports: local socket, machine (SSH/WSL command), network (LAN or Cate Connect). Cate Connect passes connection setup and runs a TURN relay; it never sees workspace plaintext. Agent means one provider CLI identity. D3: every client is the same to the runtime; no roles, no per-client permissions. D4: Noise handshake with pinned keys, only known devices; local transport is OS-user protected with a caller token reaching only the api capability. iOS push goes through an APNs target with a notification service extension.

evidence.locator: AgentId union; AGENT_DEFS table: command, resume argv, sessionStore, promptArgs, interruptKeys
evidence.finding: Exactly seven supported agent CLIs, total-record compile-checked: claude-code (claude), codex, cursor (cursor-agent), grok, kiro (kiro-cli), opencode, pi. Each declares launch command, resume argv, CLI session-store path, prompt args and interrupt keys. No gemini-cli, aider, antigravity or custom-adapter entry exists in this closed table.

evidence.title: Connected text editors
evidence.locator: Sharing rules; flush-before-submit; conflict handling
evidence.finding: Editors reachable through a terminal panel outgoing relation share a normal working file with the agent; autosave after 300ms; submitting a prompt flushes connected editors and a conflict or failed save blocks submission. Explicitly does not execute relations, send tasks automatically or coordinate agent workflows.

evidence.title: Terminal agent activity
evidence.locator: Per-CLI approval evidence table; Codex approval-mode label
evidence.finding: Per-CLI table maps hook/notification evidence to running vs waitingForInput for all seven CLIs. Settings shows a read-only Codex approvals label; there are no approval overrides and Cate never modifies a CLI permission policy.

evidence.title: Desktop product telemetry (pinned release)
evidence.locator: ANALYTICS_ENDPOINT; packaged-builds gating; CommonContext
evidence.finding: Anonymous telemetry posts to analytics.cero-ai.com; only packaged builds send; no file paths, project names, workspace contents, hostnames or account data. Payload carries a random install id plus app version/platform/arch/locale.

evidence.title: Desktop crash reporting (pinned release)
evidence.locator: initSentry: packaged gating; sendDefaultPii false; scrubbing
evidence.finding: Sentry crash reporting is always on in packaged builds (dev only with SENTRY_DSN). sendDefaultPii is false; home paths are scrubbed and navigation breadcrumbs keep only the origin.

evidence.title: First-run privacy notice (pinned release)
evidence.locator: File header; telemetry notice block; PRIVACY_URL
evidence.finding: First-run welcome shows a privacy notice stating Cate collects usage data and crash reports, informational only: there is no choice, just the privacy-policy link. Shown once per TELEMETRY_NOTICE_VERSION.

evidence.title: Cate privacy policy
evidence.locator: Desktop crash reporting and usage analytics; Cate Connect; Controller; Automatic updates
evidence.finding: Controller: 0-AI UG (haftungsbeschraenkt), Stuttgart. Desktop telemetry and crash reporting are always on from 1.3.1 and cannot be disabled; usage events cover launches/installs/updates/feature use with a random install id and exclude workspace contents, paths and AI messages. Cate Connect relays E2E-encrypted traffic it cannot read; registrations live in memory and vanish on disconnect; removing a device revokes access. Agent requests use the user own account or API key under provider terms. Packaged builds check GitHub for updates.

evidence.title: Git operations incl. PR create (pinned release)
evidence.locator: gh pr create --fill; gh pr view/list/checkout; worktree-for-PR; merge
evidence.finding: Runs host gh: pr create --fill --head for the worktree branch, pr view/list for status, pr checkout into a new worktree, plus worktree create/merge/prune. Operations time out (60-120s) and surface errors in product UI.

evidence.title: GitHub integration via host login (pinned release)
evidence.locator: gh auth status; pull-request listing and PR context
evidence.finding: GitHub works through the host gh login: connection state, the account pull-request and review-request listing, and per-PR context (head/base). Signed-out state directs the user to sign in to GitHub.

evidence.title: Repository user flows (pinned release)
evidence.locator: mergeWorktree; prune merged branches; switch panel checkout
evidence.finding: Product flows merge a worktree branch into its base with result/error reporting, delete only already-merged branches, warn about unpublished commits, and switch a panel to another checkout.

evidence.title: Worktree contract (pinned release)
evidence.locator: Branch-name sanitizer; pr-<n>-<head> folder names; checkout inheritance
evidence.finding: Free-text work descriptions become branch names; PR checkouts use pr-<n>-<head> folders. A new terminal or agent run inherits its caller checkout or a named worktree. Typing what you work on creates the worktree and branch.

evidence.title: Agent usage metering (pinned release)
evidence.locator: Usage record pricing; subscription-limit types; README Usage button
evidence.finding: Usage is recorded per agent/model and priced per day/hour from a custom override, a CLI-recorded cost or LiteLLM rates; the model also reads CLI-known subscription limits. The sidebar Usage button shows workspace token usage and API-equivalent cost by time, agent and model, plus Claude Code and Codex subscription limits. Display only; no spend enforcement.

evidence.title: Review panel session (pinned release)
evidence.locator: reviewWithAgent; requestChanges; reviewerExited; completeAgentReview
evidence.finding: Review panels compare git state or recorded edits: a read-only agent reviewer can be started over the comparison; open findings can be sent back to the source agent or a new one; a reviewer whose terminal exits without cate review complete counts as failed; only the assigned review agent may complete. Findings carry file/line/side/severity and resolve by id.

evidence.title: Agent presence registry (pinned release)
evidence.locator: Hook-anchored pid registry; falling-edge finished detection
evidence.finding: Presence derives from authenticated agent-hook posts anchored to process-table pids; the falling edge resolves finished and clears the resume stamp. Combined with shared live workspaces, every connected client sees whose agents and devices are present with full shared control.

evidence.title: Workspace notifications (pinned release)
evidence.locator: contract/capability/events/settings/gating; client attach
evidence.finding: Workspace notification contracts cover events, gating and per-setting control with one subscription per open workspace. Human permission prompts raise waitingForInput attention notifications; display is OS-native.

evidence.title: Skills install and catalog (pinned release)
evidence.locator: writeSkill/uninstall; registry/skills-index.json curated catalog; Agent Skills SKILL.md standard
evidence.finding: Skills install from a curated catalog into per-agent target dirs following the open Agent Skills SKILL.md folder standard; installs are recorded per workspace and uninstall cleanly. Relation context reaches turns via the per-agent promptContextHook (additional-context, plain-text or endpoint).

evidence.title: Official Cate extensions repository
evidence.locator: Repository description; extensions/ directory
evidence.finding: Official Cate IDE extensions: new extensions land by PR; CI builds artifacts and publishes the catalog to GitHub Pages. Pushed 2026-10-11. No license file is published in that repository.

evidence.title: Cate website
evidence.locator: Hero; download buttons; footer nav (rendered page)
evidence.finding: Hero: terminals, editors and browsers on one infinite canvas; downloads for macOS, Windows and Linux (v2.0.5 at fetch time); GitHub star count shown. Footer nav is Blog/Privacy/Impressum/GitHub; no pricing, plans, billing or Cloud-hosted-execution offer appears anywhere on the rendered page.

evidence.title: cate CLI surface (pinned release)
evidence.locator: defineCateApi/defineCliArea areas: agent, review, browser, terminal, editor, document
evidence.finding: The product-owned cate CLI exposes agent, review, browser, terminal, editor and document areas to callers in a Cate terminal (including agents), gated by read/control areas. Network pairing and device keys are covered by the architecture transport rules.

evidence.title: Panel relation graph (pinned release)
evidence.locator: RelationRole: execution/produces/targetOptions; Next/Always/Off setting; panelRelationsEnabled kill-switch
evidence.finding: Relations link panels with context/use/verify intents and produce changes, findings or notes; the relation setting is Next/Always/Off with a workspace kill-switch. Relations carry no states, assignees, priorities or due dates and are not an issue tracker.

evidence.title: Workspace availability settings (pinned release)
evidence.locator: finish/stay-available/stop choices; 5-minute stop; SSH restart note
evidence.finding: Per-workspace Availability: Finish running work (agents keep going until done), Stay available, or Stop with Cate (everything stops 5 minutes after the last window closes). A paired device can reconnect while running but cannot start a stopped workspace; reopening over SSH starts it again.

evidence.title: Agent install/login adapters (pinned release)
evidence.locator: AGENT_SETUP_ADAPTERS for all seven CLIs; allowlisted identity fields
evidence.finding: Per-agent adapters install each CLI (vendor install scripts/npm) and drive its native login (device auth, CLI auth login, Pi /login extension). Only allowlisted public identity fields leave the CLI; Cate stores no provider credentials of its own.

evidence.title: Remote runtime install (pinned release)
evidence.locator: Per-arch runtime tarballs for SSH/WSL targets
evidence.finding: The workspace runtime ships as per-architecture tarballs staged with the app and installed onto SSH or WSL machines when a workspace opens there, so local and remote follow the same path.

evidence.title: Bounded no-implementation search (pinned release)
evidence.locator: Grep across src/**, docs/**, ios/** at the pinned commit
evidence.finding: Bounded search at the pinned commit found no implementation for: scheduled/recurring runs (cron, node-schedule, recurrence terms; only timer/debounce/polling hits); webhooks (only a GraphQL language-mode label and the GitHub API client); SSO/SAML/OIDC/SCIM; container/VM isolation for workloads (docker/podman/firecracker/microVM; only Electron/webview sandboxing); a product MCP client or MCP server (only a Claude --strict-mcp-config passthrough); audit-log export; kanban/backlog/sprint/issue entities; workspace export/import; Cate Connect pricing or paid tiers. Search terms: cron, schedule, webhook, sso, saml, oidc, scim, docker, container, sandbox, microvm, firecracker, mcp, audit, kanban, backlog, sprint, export.
